kebab_example: aliyun vs manage-login --rendering-instance-id render-9f8c57355d224ad7beaf95e145f22111 --key-name mykey --key-group mygroup --action-name open --region cn-hangzhou
name: ManageLogin

parameters.help_en: ID of the Cloud Application Service instance
parameters.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en: Name of the public key. You must specify either KeyName or KeyGroup
parameters.help_zh: 公钥名称，与KeyGroup至少存在一个
parameters.name: key_name

parameters.help_en: Name of the public key group. If you do not specify KeyName, all public keys in this group are applied
parameters.help_zh: 公钥分组，如果KeyName不存在，则下发KeyGroup内所有的公钥
parameters.name: key_group

parameters.help_en:
Name of the management action. Valid values:

open — Activate the public key. This is the default value.

close — Deactivate the public key
parameters.help_zh:
管理动作名，取值：
open - 生效公钥，默认值
close - 失效公钥
parameters.name: action_name
